mapper.select: SELECT VBTT.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, VBTT.HAPPEN_DATE as hanppenDate, VBTT.BOOK_DATE as bookDate, VBTT.BOOKSET_DATE as booksetDate, VBB.BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName, VBB.STANDARD_CCY as standardCcy ,fin.FINPROD_NAME as finprodName FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO VBTT LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET VBB ON VBTT.BOOKSET_ID = VBB.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE VBBD ON VBTT.BOOKSET_ID = VBBD.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fin ON fin.FINPROD_ID = VBB.BOOKSET_ID WHERE VBTT.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND VBTT.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND VBTT.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND VBTT.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND VBTT.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND VBTT.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET}
mapper.delete: delete from BOK_BAL_TABLE_DATA where BAL_DATE = #{balDate} and BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
